# Native Java item resource library

Selected unmodified MIT source modules from the revision in `UPSTREAM.json`.
The manifest and module root isolate item selection, baking, cuboid resources and
math without an additional client, simulation, world, network or inventory owner.
Existing workspace Serde versions satisfy the APIs; no runtime compilation or JVM.
`UPSTREAM.json` records SHA-256 for each imported file; preserve LICENSE and the
shipped Native-Java-Reference-MIT notice when updating this dependency.
